article.title: ‘Citizen Osama’ turns life under bombardment into urgent, intimate cinema
article.author: Davide Abbatescianni
article.content: As NAZA draws global attention to the Gaza genocide from the perspective of Israeli génocidaires, a lesser-known Palestinian documentary looks through the camera of a Palestinian journalist trying to document devastation while keeping his family safe.
